config.title: FUNDA — Confirmation Dialog

intro.title: FUNDA — Confirmation Dialog
intro.body: In this lesson you will build a Confirmation Dialog — a modal overlay that asks "Are you sure?" before a destructive action and returns a boolean Observable that the caller awaits. You will implement two versions: one using Angular CDK Overlay for pixel-perfect positioning and focus trapping, and a lighter version using ng-template and ViewContainerRef.createEmbeddedView() for zero-dependency scenarios. A DialogService accepts any ng-template and renders it as a blocking overlay, returning the user's choice as an Observable.
intro.usecase: Confirmation dialogs are the most common modal pattern in enterprise applications — delete actions, form resets, session timeouts, destructive bulk operations, and payment confirmations. The same architecture is used by Angular Material's MatDialog.

objectives: Create a DialogService that accepts a TemplateRef and renders it as an overlay using ViewContainerRef.createEmbeddedView()
Return a Subject from the open() method and complete it with true/false when the user confirms or cancels
Build a backdrop overlay using CDK Overlay with positionStrategy set to GlobalPositionStrategy for centred display
Implement Escape key dismissal using @HostListener('document:keydown.escape') on the dialog service or overlay component
Add ARIA attributes (role="dialog", aria-modal="true", aria-labelledby) and trap focus within the dialog for accessibility
Animate the dialog entrance and exit using Angular Animations with the :enter and :leave states
Call the dialog from a table row's delete button and chain the returned Observable with switchMap to the actual delete HTTP request
